bookings_owner_idempotency_unique.name: bookings_owner_idempotency_unique
bookings_owner_idempotency_unique.where: "bookings"."idempotency_key" is not null and "bookings"."organisation_id" is null

bookings_organisation_idempotency_unique.name: bookings_organisation_idempotency_unique
bookings_organisation_idempotency_unique.where: "bookings"."idempotency_key" is not null and "bookings"."organisation_id" is not null

bookings_idempotency_key_check.name: bookings_idempotency_key_check
bookings_idempotency_key_check.value: "bookings"."idempotency_key" is null or length("bookings"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 255

bookings_supplier_fields_check.name: bookings_supplier_fields_check
bookings_supplier_fields_check.value:
(
        ("bookings"."inventory_source" = 'managed'
          and "bookings"."supplier_id" is null
          and "bookings"."supplier_reference" is null)
        or ("bookings"."inventory_source" = 'supplier'
          and "bookings"."supplier_id" is not null
          and "bookings"."supplier_reference" is not null)
      )

hotels_managed_owner_check.name: hotels_managed_owner_check
hotels_managed_owner_check.value: "hotels"."source" <> 'managed' or "hotels"."owner_user_id" is not null or "hotels"."organisation_id" is not null

ledger_entries_source_key_check.name: ledger_entries_source_key_check
ledger_entries_source_key_check.value: "ledger_entries"."source_key" is null or length("ledger_entries"."source_key") between 1 and 255

payments_idempotency_key_check.name: payments_idempotency_key_check
payments_idempotency_key_check.value: "payments"."idempotency_key" is null or length("payments"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 255

payments_claim_check.name: payments_claim_check
payments_claim_check.value:
(
        ("payments"."claim_token" is null
          and "payments"."claim_kind" is null
          and "payments"."claim_expires_at" is null)
        or ("payments"."claim_token" is not null
          and "payments"."claim_kind" in ('create', 'capture', 'refund')
          and "payments"."claim_expires_at" is not null)
      )
